sql: SELECT TOP 10 c.CatalogCode AS catalogCode, l.Code AS localeCode, s.ShippingId AS shippingId, s.ShippingCode AS shippingCode FROM dbo.ZnodePortal po INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PortalId = po.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCatalog pub ON pub.PublishCatalogId = pc.PublishCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCatalog c ON c.PimCatalogId = pub.PimCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalLocale pl ON pl.PortalId = po.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeLocale l ON l.LocaleId = pl.LocaleId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalShipping psh ON psh.PortalId = po.PortalId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeShipping s ON s.ShippingId = psh.ShippingId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState pst ON pst.PublishStateId = psh.PublishStateId WHERE po.StoreCode = @store AND pl.IsDefault = @isTrue AND l.IsActive = @isTrue AND s.ShippingCode = @shippingCode AND s.IsActive = @isTrue AND pst.PublishStateCode = @publishState ORDER BY c.CatalogCode, s.ShippingId
